integrity: The block construction, multiplier-variation mechanism, and signed-average obstruction were checked in the open-access focal preprint. The inverse estimate was reconstructed directly from the same summation-by-parts framework using phase reversal. Related invertible and two-sided Cesaro results were compared at statement and implication level. No independent audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result is a strengthening of one explicit Hilbert-space construction, not a theorem about inverses of arbitrary uniformly Kreiss bounded operators. It does not settle the two-sided absolute-Cesaro or power-boundedness questions. An equivalent short symmetry observation could exist in incompletely indexed literature.
title: A two-sided uniformly Kreiss counterexample to strong Cesàro boundedness
